break-card.alt: The list of recommended videos next to a video. The second one is the break reminder, drawn as a video: the portrait of Saint Jean-Marie Vianney as picture and channel, a clickbait title that makes fun of clickbait, and "Watching for 1 hour 7 minutes" where the views would be.

break-comment.alt: Under a video, between two comments, a comment from "Vianney" with his portrait as the picture: how long you have been watching, and that this is a good moment to take a break.

cleanup-sidebar.alt: The sidebar of YouTube with Clean up on: Home, Subscriptions, You and History. Shorts, the Explore section and More from YouTube are gone.

comment-blur.alt: Three comments under a video. The second, which takes the name of God as an exclamation, is blurred, with the reason and a Show button over it.

media-tiles.alt: Recommended videos in which the picture was judged. One is a black tile and one is blurred, each with the rule that flagged it and a Show button. The titles stay.

related-dim.alt: The list of recommended videos next to a video. Two are dimmed and labelled with the rule that flagged them: "Occult and New Age" and "Fortune telling".

subtitles-mask.alt: The bottom of a video with its caption. The words that a rule flagged are masked with blocks.
